name: Cubic Earth
summary:
In Cubic Earth's Early Access release, you can fly, walk and hang glide around a 1:1 scale voxel recreation of the planet we all call home! You can go anywhere you'd like: your hometown, old workplace, New York City, Mount Everest, or somewhere you've never even heard of.

Across the entire planet, there are millions of locations to discover and (re) experience. Pick a random place and see where you end up, look for somewhere specific, or wander until you find something interesting. Either way, you're sure to come across something worth discovering!

Additionally, the game includes a freecam Photo Mode, enabling you to take epic screenshots of your surroundings and share them with your friends! Reminisce on an old memory, plan a trip, or create content with ease.

Cubic Earth makes use of voxel technology to ensure a street level which remains coherent across the planet. Roads, trails, forests and more remain legible and navigable, unlike many planet-scale games. From places as iconic as Times Square to your local neighborhood, street level is accessible!

Familiar places can bring back memories you've long since forgotten, and new places can make for an amazing adventure. One of the most fun parts about Cubic Earth is not knowing what you'll find around the corner!
